d: Gartner is currently seeking an Associate Legal Counsel to provide commercial legal support to our business in the Gulf region. The role will support the review, drafting and negotiation of various types of contracts and commercial agreements, including framework and main service agreements, service orders and statements of work, non-disclosure agreements and related documentation.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Legal & Compliance team, Sales and other internal stakeholders to provide practical, timely and commercially focused legal support, escalating complex or high-risk matters as appropriate.
q: A motivated and collaborative legal professional with a strong interest in commercial and transactional legal work.
Able to support Sales teams in a practical and constructive manner while ensuring legally and ethically compliant contracting and business practices.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities and working with stakeholders with differing requirements.
A clear and effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
Able to identify issues, assess risks and propose practical solutions, seeking guidance when appropriate.
Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.
Open to feedback, committed to continuous learning and willing to adopt best practices.
Detail-oriented, organized and able to work effectively under deadlines.
Qualified attorney or lawyer authorized to practice in the relevant jurisdiction.
Written and verbal fluency in English and Arabic.
Approximately 3–5 years of relevant post-qualification experience supporting commercial and transactional legal matters, preferably in a law firm or corporate environment.
Experience reviewing, drafting or negotiating commercial contracts and related documentation.
Experience supporting Sales or other business teams in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively and contribute to practical, commercially focused solutions.
Strong time-management and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters simultaneously.
Basic understanding of contract management processes and legal risk assessment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with Salesforce or contract management systems is preferred.
Valid passport and no travel restrictions, if required for the role.
r: li
Review, analyze and summarize framework and main service agreements, service orders, statements of work, non-disclosure agreements and other commercial contracts.
li
Support the drafting, review and negotiation of contracts, purchase orders and contract modifications, in accordance with Gartner’s policies and approval processes.
li
Identify key legal and commercial risks and escalate complex, unusual or high-risk issues to senior members of the Legal & Compliance team.
li
Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on contractual terms, standard processes and approval requirements.
li
Support the resolution of accounts receivable issues and other contract-related business matters.
li
Participate in discussions with clients, at the request of Sales or senior Legal team members, to clarify contractual positions and explore potential solutions.
li
Maintain accurate records of contract reviews, negotiations, approvals and related legal matters.
li
Work collaboratively with Sales, Finance, Operations and other internal stakeholders to support efficient contracting processes.
li
Contribute to the development and improvement of legal processes, templates and guidance materials.
li
When requested, provide support to other Legal & Compliance teams on regional matters, including corporate, privacy and compliance-related activities.
li
Support the preparation and delivery of training or guidance sessions for internal teams, as appropriate.

d: M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

The General Practitioner - Family Medicine is responsible for delivering comprehensive, evidence-based primary healthcare to patients across different age groups. The role focuses on diagnosing and managing acute and chronic conditions, providing preventive care, promoting healthy lifestyles, and coordinating referrals to ensure continuity of care. The successful candidate will practise within granted clinical privileges while maintaining M42’s standards for patient safety, clinical quality, regulatory compliance, and person-centred care.
q: Medical degree such as Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, Doctor of Medicine, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
Completion of the required internship and clinical training.
Valid General Practitioner licence from the Department of Health, Abu Dhabi, or eligibility to obtain one.
Relevant experience in Family Medicine, primary healthcare, outpatient care, or a comparable clinical setting.
Demonstrated ability to manage acute illnesses, chronic diseases, preventive care, and general medical presentations.
Current Basic Life Support certification; Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support certification is preferred.
Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and decision-making capabilities.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work in a multidisciplinary environment.
Commitment to ethical practice, confidentiality, patient safety, clinical quality, and continuous professional development.
